Question 12
?

The position vector r(t) of a particle P relative to a fixed origin O at time t is given by r(t)=⟨3t3+t,ln⁡t⟩,t>0. Calculate the acceleration vector a.

a
 a=⟨9t2+1,1t⟩
b
a=⟨18t,−1t2⟩
c
a=⟨18,1t2⟩
d
 a=⟨18t,−2t⟩
e
 a=⟨9t2+1,−1t2⟩
